name: Soul Conduit
body:
Your devotion to the gods of death is greater than the bond with your phantom.

Prerequisite(s): Spiritualist level 1st.

Benefit(s): You know how to manipulate the energies of death and undeath better than other spiritualists. You add the following spells both to your class spell list (if not already on that list) and your list of spells known; they are in addition to the normal number of spells known for your level.

1st—ray of enfeeblement, 2nd—command undead, 3rd—halt undead, 4th—deathless, 5th—blood tentacles, 6th—temporary resurrection.

Special: A character cannot have both this feat and the Emotional Conduit feat.
